decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The pitched roofs due to their size, scale, design, and appearance, would be acceptable and not harm the appearance of the area, or neighbouring residents' living conditions.  The development is in accordance with policies IMP.3.4 (Housing Estate Regeneration), ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.1.2 (High Buildings or Structures Affecting Sensitive Areas), and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

(Reason.  In order that the Council may be satisfied as to the details of the development in the interests of the visual amenity of the area.)

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 5 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason. To protect the visual amenities of the areaand to ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the amenities of the locality.)

Condition : 6 - The internal space within the approved roof extensions shall not be used to create any living accommodation.

REASON:  To ensure that the site is not overdeveloped and to protect the amenities of adjoining residential properties.
description: Construction of pitched roofs over blocks 56-106, 25-55, 81-139, 134-192, 141-199.
